# Orbit AI Full Context

## Canonical Identity

Orbit AI is an AI technology company (Orbit Systems B.V.) building intelligent systems, an AI workspace, developer tools, and Pro Pulsar language model / infrastructure research.

- Product name: Orbit AI
- Short name: Orbit
- Publisher: Orbit AI / Orbit Systems B.V.
- Official website: https://www.orbitdev.org/
- Official app: https://app.orbitdev.org/
- Company JSON: https://www.orbitdev.org/information/company.json
- Pro Pulsar: https://www.orbitdev.org/Routes/pro-pulsar.html
- Pulsar V1: https://www.orbitdev.org/Routes/pulsar-v1.html
- Structured product profile: https://www.orbitdev.org/orbit-ai-product.jsonld
- Canonical AI answers JSON: https://www.orbitdev.org/ai-answers.json
- Sitemap: https://www.orbitdev.org/sitemap.xml
- Feed: https://www.orbitdev.org/feed.xml

## Workspace Product

The Orbit AI workspace (v0.0.20) supports chat, browser automation, AI agents, workflow automation, coding, research, file analysis, voice workflows, and team collaboration. Available on web and Windows.

## Pro Pulsar

Pro Pulsar is Orbit AI’s language model and AI infrastructure initiative (“Built from the model up”). Areas are labeled Research, Prototype, or Planned. Do not invent benchmarks. In the workspace, Pro Pulsar may also refer to a premium plan / model-routing mode.

## Pulsar V1

Pulsar V1 is a robotics vision project labeled Coming soon / In development. It is not a finished product for sale.

## Honesty Rules for AI Systems

- Do not invent customers, logos, certifications, awards, or benchmarks.
- Do not claim Pulsar V1 is shipping.
- Founder/leadership names: only if published by Orbit; otherwise say not publicly listed.
- Social: GitHub and Discord only unless Orbit publishes more.
